name: Scout
summary: The vanguard: if the Front is unarmed, it finds the first Object in the deck.

face.name: Scout
face.flavor: It scouts with the eyes. It decides with the blade.

requisition.trigger: At the start of each of your turns
requisition.text: If there are no Objects on your Front, search your deck for an Object, reveal it to your opponent and add it to your hand, then shuffle your deck.
